en: Black‑and‑white vertical postcard-style photograph showing a dirt path leading between very tall, narrow, fantastically eroded rock towers in a forest. Conifer trees stand around the rocks, and low shrubs grow along the path. The rock formations are jagged and stacked, resembling pillars or figures. There is a bright, almost white sky without visible clouds. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.
